purpose: Test whether independently generated Torch: Dominions protagonist attack poses can function as a coherent character animation.

excluded_alternate.reason: Alternate pose candidate; not used in the labeled three-beat sequence.

visual_review.identity: fail: hair changes from long dark auburn flowing hair (anticipation) to a shorter tied-back shape (contact) and then reddish ponytail (recovery); face and apparent age/proportions also drift.
visual_review.torch_ownership: fail: anticipation/contact depict one held violet lantern; recovery visibly introduces a second flame/torch in the other hand while retaining the lantern in the extended hand.
visual_review.torch_design: fail: lantern shape and scale change between frames; in recovery it is a different, enlarged cage-like design.
visual_review.silhouette: fail: costume silhouette, mantle/cape outline, facing and body pose change substantially; not a controlled continuation of one attack.
visual_review.action_continuity: fail: the recovery image does not recover from the contact strike; it reads as a separately staged pose with different equipment and orientation.
visual_review.gameplay_scale: not assessed in engine; source frames are 1024x1024 RGB concept images on opaque backgrounds, not transparent game-ready sprites.
visual_review.playback_timing: not approved or assembled as gameplay motion because the source poses fail identity/equipment continuity.

technical_audit.interpretation: Technical alignment/difference metrics only. The tool explicitly does not evaluate semantic identity or artistic motion quality.

cutout_feasibility_test.method: OpenCV 5.0 GrabCut, initialized from the neutral grey border color and a hand-bounded probable-foreground rectangle; six graph-cut iterations; largest connected component retained; 3x3 Gaussian alpha edge softening.

inspection.result: Character silhouette largely retained, but the cutout is one fused whole-character layer: torso, limbs, hair, grip, and torch are not separated for rigging. A wide opaque shadow strip under the boots and a grey-tinted smoke remnant at the torch top remain included as foreground. The soft alpha edge halo is visible on checkerboard review.
inspection.rig_suitability: fail: translating/rotating this one layer cannot create an articulated torch strike; segmenting limbs/torch from this source would require destructive reconstruction at joints and through the grip.

cutout_feasibility_test.decision: Keep as a background-removal feasibility artifact only. Do not call it a clean game-ready sprite, separate rig, or animation.

decision: Do not interpolate or integrate the independent pose set as animation. The one-source GrabCut result is also not a usable character rig. Preserve both experiments as evidence: prompting and whole-character segmentation cannot supply stable pose continuity or independently articulated parts from these sources.
next_gate: Obtain or author a clean approved layered character source with distinct torso, arm/hand/torch, legs, head/hair, mantle, and shadow/VFX layers, or a stable rigged model; preserve the chosen face, hair, costume, torch silhouette and right-hand grip. Then animate anticipation/contact/recovery and review the actual motion and seams at gameplay scale.
human_review: The user supplied the three-pose contact sheet; no formal art-direction or release approval is implied.
